bodyHtml:
ROT-2 Reverse Osmosis Storage Tank

8-Liter (2.0 Gallon) Tank for Café Makers & Table Systems | Aquasky RO-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

The ROT-2 tank, with an 8-liter (2.0-gallon) volume, is designed for reverse osmosis, café, and tabletop systems, delivering safe, pure, pressurized water. 

 

Its maximum operating pressure is 7 bar (100 psi) and maximum temperature is 90 °C (194 °F). Pre-charged with 100% nitrogen to 0.5-0.7 bar (7-10 psi) for stable performance regardless of temperature.

 

With dimensions of 20.3 cm (8.0 inches) diameter and 28.7 cm (11.3 inches) height, it offers large storage in an adaptable form factor for commercial and tabletop setups.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The ROT-2 is an 8-liter (2.0 gallon) diaphragm pressure tank designed for reverse osmosis (RO) systems, café makers, and table systems. Equivalent to the industry-standard RO120, it securely stores purified water and delivers it with controlled, robust pressure. Ideal for commercial beverage applications, the ROT-2 features a hygienic internal design that prevents water from contacting the metal tank shell. 

Utilizing an FDA-approved polypropylene liner and a DIN 4807-compliant butyl rubber diaphragm, it ensures safe operation and fresh, tasteless water free of rubber or plastic odors. 

Manufactured with premium materials and holding top-tier certifications including NSF58, CE, and IAPMO, Aquasky RO tanks are produced in ISO 9001:2008 registered facilities to deliver a long service life, dependable performance, and the safest drinking-water compatibility on the market.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • Epoxy powder exterior painting for high oxidation protection and aesthetic finish.
  • Stainless-steel, lead-free, chemical-free, patented leak-safe water connection (Aquasky invention in 18 years).
  • High-performance butyl rubber diaphragm meets DIN 4807 standards.
  • Internal virgin FDA-approved polypropylene liner prevents purified water from contacting metal.
  • Patented leakage-free O-ring sealed air valve cap.
  • 100% factory pre-charged with nitrogen (not air).
  • 100% pressure tested before shipment for ultimate reliability.
  • High level of customization for distinct market branding.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the RO-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

ROT-2 stores supplemental water securely between the butyl rubber diaphragm and the polypropylene liner, while the nitrogen-filled air chamber maintains constant system pressure. When a drinking tap or coffee maker is activated, the compressed nitrogen pushes the purified water into the system at a controlled pressure.

This specialized design ensures stable performance, completely separates the water from the metal shell, and maintains a clean water zone that is completely free of rubber or plastic odors.

Key benefits

  • Delivers cleaner, fresher, and better-tasting water by isolating the water supply from metals and plastics
  • Provides a tasteless water zone with absolutely no rubber or plastic smells
  • Guarantees zero air loss and exceptional air resistance, outperforming other tanks on the market
  • Completely maintenance-free during its entire expected service life

Typical Applications

  • Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems
  • Café makers and commercial coffee equipment
  • Tabletop drinking systems

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : Can I use the ROT-2 for a commercial café maker and table system?

Absolutely. The 8-liter (2.0-gallon) capacity of the ROT-2 provides ample pressurized water storage perfectly sized for café makers and tabletop water dispensing systems without taking up excess space.

Q2 : Is the ROT-2 safe for storing my drinking water?

Yes. The ROT-2 uses a high-grade polypropylene liner and a butyl diaphragm made with FDA-approved materials, which completely prevents the water from ever making contact with the metal tank shell. 

This guarantees a tasteless water zone with no rubber or plastic smells, making it perfectly safe for clean drinking water. Furthermore, the stainless steel connector is chemical-free and lead-free.

Q3 : Does the ROT-2 require regular maintenance or air recharging?

No. The ROT-2 is designed to be entirely maintenance-free during its service life. We utilize a specialized brass cap with an internal O-ring that guarantees no air loss from the air vent. 

Additionally, it is the only RO storage tank in the industry pre-charged with 100% Nitrogen, which naturally resists permeation and prevents pressure fluctuations caused by temperature changes
